response.sql: SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "High side of a 47.6 cutoff" means strictly greater than 47.6 (bandusagepct > 47.6); a value exactly equal to 47.6 is excluded.
Ties in count at the top-10 boundary are broken arbitrarily since no secondary ordering was requested.
Telescopes with NULL lunarstage still form a group (NULL moon phase) and are counted.

alternatives.interpretation: The high side includes the cutoff itself (bandusagepct >= 47.6).
